title: Scope and bound quotation conversion report queries
description: A salesperson opens the existing quotation conversion report and sees only quotations for customers currently assigned to them. Require a positive authenticated user, existing quotation menu permission and freshly resolved salesperson scope on every HTTP call; fail closed for missing context, revoked permission or unmapped users. Add a mandatory explicit scope argument to the application method and update its existing callers/tests. Validate start/end before source reads, allow at most 366 inclusive calendar days and use an exclusive upper-date boundary. Bound materialization to 2000 scoped quotations (read at most 2001 to detect overflow); over-limit requests must ask the user to narrow the date range and return no partial metrics. Query PI/order conversion links only for scoped IDs in finite chunks below SQL Server parameter limits; preserve current conversion, cancellation and expiry rules. No source entity or persistence model change is needed. Development only: reuse existing ERP services, current-user menu permissions and SalespersonDataScopeService; OperationLogMiddleware audits API calls. No new authorization privileges, direct table writes, arbitrary SQL, schema/migration/stored-procedure/view changes, production SQL, real database execution, irreversible actions, secrets/.env changes, deployment or real browser acceptance. Verify focused in-memory or source-contract tests and the configured safe Release build/test; unavailable external environments must be marked blocked, never reported passed. Preserve unrelated work.
acceptance_criteria: Every quotation-conversion HTTP call validates identity and the existing quotation menu permission and resolves current customer scope; restricted or unmapped accounts cannot see other or null-customer quotations.

Mandatory scope and inclusive date validation (maximum 366 days) precede reads; at most 2001 scoped quotations are read and more than 2000 produce an explicit narrow-range error rather than partial totals; conversion links use bounded batches.

Existing quotation governance callers/tests explicitly provide scope; focused tests cover revoked access, unmapped users, null customers, dates, overflow, link batching and unchanged conversion rules, and safe Release build/test passes.
